literal: Among those things that are obtained, we know of nothing else that is a blessing, other than the obtaining of children who have acquired knowledge.
translation: Among all the blessings one can obtain in life, we know of none greater than the acquisition of children who possess wisdom.
modern: பெறக்கூடிய பேறுகளுள், அறிவு நிறைந்த பிள்ளைகளைப் பெறுவதைத் தவிர வேறு சிறந்த பேறு இருப்பதாக நாங்கள் அறியவில்லை.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme value of having wise and knowledgeable children. The author states that among all the fortunes, wealth, or achievements a person can acquire in life, there is nothing of greater value than obtaining children who possess true understanding and wisdom. The phrase 'arivarinda makkal' emphasizes that it is not merely having offspring, but having children endowed with discerning knowledge and character that constitutes the ultimate blessing.
